carryover: Direct widget Browser Action test logs showed false success/failure mismatches, polling/stability failures, and manual debug feedback being learned as negative semantic corrections even when the user marked the action successful.
confirmedDecisions: Treat user manual debug feedback as labeled runtime evidence before semantic-memory training.
Only failure or partial wrong-target feedback may create avoid_target correction edges.
Real-use audit matching must prefer request/message ids and avoid repeated-prompt prompt-only false positives.
Side-effect Browser Action execution should retry Browser Perception when the observed context is still mutating.
newGoal: Improve Browser Action real-use reliability by adding regressions and fixes for feedback outcome classification, eval/debug correlation, timezone-safe audits, and mutating-context stabilization.
